request.query: Consider the Agency Agreement for Asset Sale between The Bon-Ton Stores, Inc., GA Retail, Inc., Tiger Capital Group, LLC, and Wilmington Savings Fund Society, FSB; Is there an anti-assignment clause in this contract?
